name: The Core
desc: A simple exercise in spatial wrapping. Navigate to the right and swallow the essence.

name: First Squeeze
desc: Slide through the opening left in the barrier to reach the essence.

name: Topological Shift
desc: A single barrier forces you to roll around the outer perimeter.

name: Double Feed
desc: Enclose two split essences. You must roll back and forth carefully.

name: The Watcher
desc: Avoid the slow moving parasite guarding the vertical gap.

name: Chamber Split
desc: Two chambers connected by a narrow tunnel.

name: Dual Orbit
desc: Collect essences surrounding a central structural void pillar.

name: Narrow Passage
desc: Be careful not to snap while translating through the central horizontal split.

name: Parasite Patrol
desc: A parasite moves horizontally across your path. Time your loop stretch.

name: Corner Trap
desc: A tight spot holds the target essence. Enter and reverse carefully.

name: Alternator
desc: Two obstacles require winding moves. Plan your loop's dynamic curve.

name: The Guard Dog
desc: The parasite sweeps the only safe entry channel. Sync your cycle.

name: T-Crossing
desc: Navigate the tricky intersections to consume dual essences.

name: Split Gateways
desc: Choose between the upper or lower path. One is safer, one is faster.

name: Islands of Trust
desc: Warp your layout across small platform blocks without breaking symmetry.

name: The Vertical Wave
desc: A continuous wall forces a series of sharp up-and-down maneuvers.

name: Double Trouble
desc: Two patrolling bugs cross paths. Find the safe temporal window.

name: Topological Lock
desc: The essence is protected inside an incomplete ring of voids.

name: Symmetric Vault
desc: A puzzle requiring balanced moves left and right.

name: Spiral Inward
desc: Wind your way inside a winding spiral corridor to collect the essence.

name: Speed Traps
desc: Quickly slip past fast, localized parasites.

name: Bifurcation
desc: Split decision. Ensure your loop tail is clear of hazards.

name: The Gridiron
desc: A rigid checkerboard of voids. Deform step-by-step.

name: Slalom Run
desc: Zigzag horizontally to reach the dual nodes at the right boundary.

name: Weave and Bob
desc: A moving parasite coordinates with tight columns.

name: Pressure Chamber
desc: Small spaces mean high self-intersection probability.

name: Central Core Blockade
desc: A massive block sits in the center. Swing around it cleanly.

name: Syncopation
desc: Synchronize loop contractions with two moving patrol phases.

name: The Hook
desc: A hook-shaped corridor guards the path. Navigate around the bend to reach the target.

name: Crossover Alley
desc: Two parasites sweep horizontally across the map grid.

name: Topological Prism
desc: Three essences in highly isolated outer pocket sectors.

name: Gatekeeper
desc: A single parasite blocks the inner sanctum. Bait and switch.

name: Checker Clash
desc: Navigate checkerboard blocks while an active parasite intercepts tracks.

name: Hourglass Corridor
desc: A very tight choke point. You must align your nodes perfectly linearly.

name: Threading the Needle
desc: Avoid touch blocks that leave exactly one node space of breathing room.

name: Side Winder
desc: A horizontal snake course with a parasite tracking the curves.

name: Gridiron Split
desc: Split walls segmenting four separate essence targets.

name: The Centipede
desc: A long parasite snake blocks central lanes. Move defensively.

name: The Outer Rim
desc: Outer edges are clear, but central paths are blocked by voids.

name: Subway System
desc: Parallel channels with alternating direction patrols.

name: Helix Chamber
desc: An elaborate double helix track with narrow bypass points.

name: The gauntlet
desc: A long straight line populated by four rapid vertical patrols.

name: Enclosure Lockout
desc: Targets require capturing other objects concurrently to hit the count.

name: The Sieve
desc: An extremely porous wall forces the loop to break into multiple thin tracks.

name: Cross Check
desc: A grid matrix with horizontal and vertical guards sliding past each other.

name: Decompression
desc: Move into massive spaces but construct loops small enough to avoid obstacles.

name: Spike Runner
desc: A speed-run horizontal track inside highly dangerous spikes.

name: The Trident
desc: Three separate long narrow corridors. You must stretch to reach them.

name: Mirror Match
desc: Perfect spatial mirroring required to hit targets on both poles simultaneously.

name: Ouroboros Mastery
desc: The ultimate test. Tight pathways, hyper fast patrols, extreme coordination.
